request.state: My card was charged twice for the same order on the same morning.

q1.instructions: Which of these codes fits the note?

criteria.double_charge: The same order was paid for more than once.
criteria.wrong_amount: The amount charged is not the amount on the order.
criteria.refund_late: A refund was promised and has not arrived.
criteria.other: None of the three above fits this note.
